stops.name: Altkünkendorf Information Center
stops.quote: Welcome to the website of the Altkünkendorf Information Center at the Buchenwald Grumsin UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site—Brandenburg’s only UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site!

stops.name: Grumsin Beech Forest
stops.quote: The beech forest of Grumsin is located in the heart of the Schorfheide-Chorin biosphere reserve, about 80 kilometres northeast of Berlin.
stops.english: The beech forest of Grumsin is located in the heart of the Schorfheide-Chorin biosphere reserve, about 80 kilometres northeast of Berlin.
